about_the_game:
Trial Version Instructions

This trial version only includes partial areas of some levels. The content will undergo significant changes during development and does not represent the final quality.

Summary

In this exploration game rooted in the Chinese “dreamcore” aesthetic, briefly escape the noisy present and fall into the blurry dreams of the millennium, to relive and collect memories from days gone by...

This demo includes the following levels:

The Way Home

Everything here is so familiar, as if you’ve returned to your childhood home. But at the same time, there’s a sense of unfamiliarity—you suddenly realize that there’s no one here anymore...

Deserted Pedestrian Street

It feels like that evening again, going with your parents to the underground mall where the air was filled with the scents of fabric and dampness. But now, only the lonely mannequins guard this forgotten corner.

Error Space-H

You do not belong here. Everything here is illogical, like a crude imitation of reality. Although the pool water might make you feel relaxed, don’t linger—pass through quickly.

name: MillenniumDream Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • Storage: 10 MB available space

short_description: Stroll through spaces built by memories of the millennium, feeling the fusion of Chinese dreamcore and liminal space aesthetics. Use a camera to capture corners forgotten by memory, collect fragments of childhood, and relive the beauty or fear of times gone by.
supported_languages:
English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
